subject: Sierra’s agent protocol 🤖, Infoblox data breach 🔓, Cloudflare open-sources Kitesurf 🪁
notes: No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs, funds or pricing changes in this issue; only top news stories extracted.

stories.headline: Sierra releases version 1.0 of the Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy); Shopify enables it for merchants
stories.quote:
Sierra has released version 1.0 of the Personal Agent Protocol, known
as Poppy, a standard that enables personal agents to interact securely
with businesses. Shopify has enabled the protocol for its merchants
stories.description: Released a standard for personal agents to interact securely with businesses

facts.text: Design partners Mercury, Synchrony and Turkish Airlines are going live with implementations.
facts.quote:
design partners including Mercury, Synchrony, and Turkish Airlines
are going live with implementations

facts.text: v1.0 integrates with OAuth and OpenAPI and has a commerce extension co-authored by Shopify.
facts.quote:
integrates with existing standards like OAuth
and OpenAPI, and features a commerce extension co-authored by Shopify

stories.headline: Infoblox investigates breach via compromised migration vendor; customer and employee data stolen from SharePoint
stories.quote:
Infoblox is investigating a compromised migration vendor whose access
was reportedly used to steal SharePoint data, including customer
network configurations and sensitive employee information.

facts.text: Infoblox says it found no indication its products, cloud services or software releases were involved.
facts.quote:
The company
says it has found no indication that its products, cloud services, or
software releases were involved.

stories.headline: Gartner predicts weak AI governance will disrupt 40% of infrastructure and operations organizations scaling AI by 2028
stories.quote:
Gartner predicts weak governance will cause business-critical
disruptions at 40% of infrastructure and operations organizations
scaling AI by 2028.

facts.text: Survey: 15% of respondents have automatic circuit breakers for runaway agents; 95% reported an agent-related incident in the past year.
facts.quote:
only 15% of respondents have
automatic circuit breakers to stop runaway agents, despite 95%
reporting an agent-related incident in the past year

stories.headline: Cloudflare open-sources Kitesurf, its stateless browser for AI agents, under Apache 2.0
stories.quote:
Cloudflare has open-sourced Kitesurf, its stateless browser for AI
agents that runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers. Available under the
Apache 2.0 license on GitHub

stories.headline: Dell announces Agentic Data Gateway and hybrid pipelines connecting agents to enterprise data
stories.quote:
Dell announced an Agentic Data Gateway and hybrid pipelines that
connect agents to approved enterprise data, models, and tools on
customer-controlled infrastructure.

facts.text: Integrations with LangChain, OpenAI Codex and Unstructured.
facts.quote:
Integrations with LangChain,
OpenAI Codex, and Unstructured add agent development and
document-processing capabilities.

stories.headline: GitHub Copilot app adds support for GitHub Enterprise Server repositories, issues and pull requests
stories.quote:
The Copilot app now supports GitHub Enterprise Server repositories,
issues, and pull requests, although cloud sessions remain unavailable
for those repositories.

stories.headline: United Launch Alliance rocket fails to deliver 40 Amazon broadband satellites to orbit
stories.quote:
A United Launch Alliance rocket failed to deliver 40 Amazon broadband
satellites to orbit after an anomaly during Sunday's flight.

facts.text: First mission to use a Vulcan configuration tailored for Amazon's constellation; impact on later launches unclear.
facts.quote:
The
mission was the first to use a Vulcan configuration tailored for
Amazon's constellation, and the impact on subsequent launches remains
unclear.

stories.headline: NVIDIA releases SkillEvaluator, a framework for evaluating AI agent skills
stories.quote:
NVIDIA has released SkillEvaluator, a multi-tier framework for
evaluating AI agent skills through quality gates, semantic overlap
detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent
testing.
